prompt: A calm still-life photograph-quality 3D render for the "all services healthy" state of a dark operations dashboard. Six small smooth matte stones in graphite and charcoal tones rest in a gentle, evenly spaced arc on a flat matte-black surface; everything is still and balanced. A single thin cool-blue rim light (#3b82f6, subtle, low intensity) grazes the stones from behind so each stone carries a hairline blue edge highlight; no other color. Very soft falloff, deep shadows, generous negative space on the left third. The background and the edges of the frame are a flat, even near-black exactly #131416 with no vignette gradient banding, so the image sits seamlessly on a #131416 panel. Quiet, precise, engineered mood. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no screens, no UI, no glow haze, no lens flare.
